name: The Crown Valley
description: A warm valley kingdom where bread ovens, marriage houses, lesson halls, and market bells all orbit the Hearthwell. It is the safest starting home, but every family here knows the well can hear an oath breaking.

name: Mireglass Lowlands
description: A wetland of mirror pools where grief becomes light on the water and old promises can be read in ripples. Herbalists, mourners, and memory keepers travel by lantern between reed houses.

name: The Ash-Ring Marches
description: Volcanic marches built around ruined watch-forts and oath forges. Ashkin patrols hold the passes while smiths temper tools in mineral heat and monsters nest in cooled lava tubes.

name: Saffron Coast
description: A chain of bright ports where salt pans, fish markets, sail shrines, and immigrant quarters trade news faster than coin. Every festival smells of saffron, brine, and risky bargains.

name: Highroot Canopy
description: A vertical forest society of rope bridges, rain drums, carved lifts, and canopy gardens. The Highroot Clans govern by listening to trees, animals, and weather before they vote.

name: The Quiet North
description: Snow provinces where time feels thin and every road has ancestor stones watching it. Archive houses keep cold lamps burning over lineage secrets and rare topogenic crystals.

name: The Subframe Labyrinth
description: A dynamic dungeon layer below every Hearthwell. Its rooms reassemble around unresolved hunger, fear, rivalry, and taboo, turning civic pressure into corridors you can walk.
